/**
 * @module
 * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
 */

import type { Context } from '../../context'
import type { MiddlewareHandler } from '../../types'

export type RequestIdVariables = {
  requestId: string
}

export type RequestIdOptions = {
  limitLength?: number
  headerName?: string
  generator?: (c: Context) => string
  /**
   * Whether to trust an incoming request ID header.
   *
   * When `true` (default), a valid incoming ID is reused.
   * When `false`, any incoming ID is ignored and `generator` is always used.
   *
   * @default true
   */
  trustIncoming?: boolean
}

/**
 * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
 *
 * @param {object} options - Options for Request ID middleware.
 * @param {number} [options.limitLength=255] - The maximum length of request id.
 * @param {string} [options.headerName=X-Request-Id] - The header name used in request id.
 * @param {generator} [options.generator=() => crypto.randomUUID()] - The request id generation function.
 * @param {boolean} [options.trustIncoming=true] - Whether to trust an incoming request id header.
 *
 * @returns {MiddlewareHandler} The middleware handler function.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * type Variables = RequestIdVariables
 * const app = new Hono<{Variables: Variables}>()
 *
 * app.use(requestId())
 * app.get('/', (c) => {
 *   console.log(c.get('requestId')) // Debug
 *   return c.text('Hello World!')
 * })
 * ```
 */
export const requestId = ({
  limitLength = 255,
  headerName = 'X-Request-Id',
  generator = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
  trustIncoming = true,
}: RequestIdOptions = {}): MiddlewareHandler => {
  return async function requestId(c, next) {
    // If `headerName` is empty string, req.header will return the object
    let reqId = trustIncoming && headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
    if (!reqId || reqId.length > limitLength || /[^\w\-=]/.test(reqId)) {
      reqId = generator(c)
    }

    c.set('requestId', reqId)
    if (headerName) {
      c.header(headerName, reqId)
    }
    await next()

/**
 * @module
 * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
 */

import type { Context } from '../../context'
import type { MiddlewareHandler } from '../../types'

export type RequestIdVariables = {
  requestId: string
}

export type RequestIdOptions = {
  limitLength?: number
  headerName?: string
  generator?: (c: Context) => string
  /**
   * Whether to trust an incoming request ID header.
   *
   * When `true` (default), a valid incoming ID is reused.
   * When `false`, any incoming ID is ignored and `generator` is always used.
   *
   * @default true
   */
  trustIncoming?: boolean
}

/**
 * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
 *
 * @param {object} options - Options for Request ID middleware.
 * @param {number} [options.limitLength=255] - The maximum length of request id.
 * @param {string} [options.headerName=X-Request-Id] - The header name used in request id.
 * @param {generator} [options.generator=() => crypto.randomUUID()] - The request id generation function.
 * @param {boolean} [options.trustIncoming=true] - Whether to trust an incoming request id header.
 *
 * @returns {MiddlewareHandler} The middleware handler function.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * type Variables = RequestIdVariables
 * const app = new Hono<{Variables: Variables}>()
 *
 * app.use(requestId())
 * app.get('/', (c) => {
 *   console.log(c.get('requestId')) // Debug
 *   return c.text('Hello World!')
 * })
 * ```
 */
export const requestId = ({
  limitLength = 255,
  headerName = 'X-Request-Id',
  generator = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
  trustIncoming = true,
}: RequestIdOptions = {}): MiddlewareHandler => {
  return async function requestId(c, next) {
    // If `headerName` is empty string, req.header will return the object
    let reqId = trustIncoming && headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
    if (!reqId || reqId.length > limitLength || /[^\w\-=]/.test(reqId)) {
      reqId = generator(c)
    }

    c.set('requestId', reqId)
    if (headerName) {
      c.header(headerName, reqId)
    }
    await next()
  }
}

Implemented and verified.

## Changes

**`src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`**
- Added `trustIncoming?: boolean` to `RequestIdOptions` with JSDoc, `@default true` (`request-id.ts:23`).
- Destructured `trustIncoming = true`, preserving existing behavior by default (`request-id.ts:55`).
- Header lookup now short-circuits when `trustIncoming` is false, so the existing validation/regeneration path always calls `generator(c)` (`request-id.ts:59`). `c.set('requestId', reqId)` and the response header are unchanged, so the generated value is still exposed through both.

**`src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts`**
- Added a `trustIncoming` describe block covering:
  - default (trusts incoming header),
  - explicit `trustIncoming: true`,
  - `trustIncoming: false` ignores a valid incoming header and uses the generator,
  - `trustIncoming: false` with no header generates and exposes the value.

## Verification

     Tests  15 passed (15)

Types remain `boolean | undefined`, and all changes are left unstaged for review.
